title: Ska
tagline: Upbeat, syncopated rhythm with a brass-heavy punch.
summary: Ska brings jazz, Caribbean mento and rhythm and blues into a fast, danceable form with a strong offbeat accent. It is lively and communal, often mixing horns, guitar and a lighthearted sense of motion. The style helped shape later reggae and punk scenes while keeping its own festive energy.

pillars.name: The Skatalites
pillars.why: The Skatalites gave ska its foundational sound, combining brass fire with a highly rhythmic, modern groove.

pillars.name: Desmond Dekker
pillars.why: Desmond Dekker made ska’s crossover energy widely audible beyond the island itself.

pillars.name: Madness
pillars.why: Madness carried ska into a new pop era with melodic hooks and larger audiences.
